title: ‘The Art of Breaking Up’ moves BINI Jhoanna to tears; says she hopes to return to theater
summary: BINI’s Jhoanna was visibly tearful during the media preview of “The Art of Breaking Up” at the PETA Theater Center in Quezon City on Thursday.
